decisions: Alias versions: 20.3.34, 21.2.25, 22.2.4. Latest 20.3.35 and 21.2.26 are quarantined by Yarn npmMinimalAgeGate (1440 min) and were not bypassed.
Yarn 4 does not enforce dependency engines: install with the v22 alias (engines ^22.22.3||^24.15.0||>=26) succeeded under Node 22.13.0. engines left unchanged; v22 tests skip below its floor.
ThisReceiver does not extend ImplicitReceiver in v21, so member matching tests both classes (explicit this. bypasses template locals).

Two-way [(x)]=y is reported as TemplatePropertyWrite from the BoundAttribute; the paired TwoWay BoundEvent is skipped to avoid duplicates (BindingType.TwoWay=5, ParsedEventType.TwoWay=2 are stable across 20-22).
Angular 20+ removed PropertyWrite; assignments are Binary with =, +=, etc.
templateAttrs (structural microsyntax) are not visited by the compiler's recursive visitor, so the extractor visits them explicitly in the outer scope.
Inline template spans are exact only when cooked text equals source text; escapes/CRLF yield template_unresolved (fail closed).
Missing templateUrl target maps to template_unresolved; lexical escape check precedes existence so '../../x.html' is template_unsafe.
Non-member symbols, static members, and members of non-component classes without derived components return not_applicable.
Planning docs under openspec/changes were reformatted by prettier so format:check passes.
Validator fix: the 512 KiB cap now applies to inline templates too (shared check before parse).
